scripts.staging:migrate: docker exec $(docker ps -q -f name=loopedu-be) sh -c 'DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL="${DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}" node apps/api/src/db/migrate.ts'
scripts.staging:seed: docker exec $(docker ps -q -f name=loopedu-be) sh -c 'DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL="${DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}" node apps/api/dist/db/seed.js'
